title: Deformation, load and proportional response
concepts_taught: Distinguish tensile and compressive forces in one dimension.
Use load, extension and compression to describe changes in length.
State the condition built into Hooke’s law.
Calculate and interpret spring constant from force and extension.
Identify the limit of proportionality on force-extension data.
Construct and interpret force-extension graphs and compare stiffness.
skills_students_can_now_use: Explain and apply: understand that deformation is caused by tensile or compressive forces (forces and deformations will be assumed to be in one dimension only)
Explain and apply: understand and use the terms load, extension, compression and limit of proportionality
Explain and apply: recall and use Hooke’s law
Explain and apply: recall and use the formula for the spring constant k = F / x
